name: meshin-co-site
description: meshin.co — Astro 7 static site for a Fractional Chief AI Officer practice

scripts.assets:logo: node scripts/generate-logo.mjs && node scripts/generate-favicons.mjs && prettier --write src/components/common/LogoMark.astro src/components/common/LogoSymbol.astro --log-level warn
scripts.build: astro build && node scripts/gen-edge-worker.mjs dist && node scripts/gen-openapi.mjs dist && node scripts/gen-agent-catalog.mjs dist && node scripts/gen-headers.mjs dist && node scripts/generate-static-sidecars.mjs dist && node scripts/search-page-text.mjs dist && node scripts/gate.mjs dist budgets.json
scripts.check: npm run check:astro && npm run check:eslint && npm run check:prettier
scripts.fix: npm run fix:eslint && npm run fix:prettier
scripts.gate:lh: node -e "if(!process.env.GATE_PHASE)throw new Error('gate:lh: GATE_PHASE must name the bucket these audits belong to, for example GATE_PHASE=13-free-analytics')" && node scripts/run-lh-parallel.mjs
scripts.gate:lh:one: if [ "$(node scripts/lh-routes.cjs --count)" = 0 ]; then echo '0 touched routes to audit'; else rm -rf "${LH_OUTPUT_DIR:-.lighthouseci}" && { lhci autorun --config=lighthouserc.cjs; status=$?; node scripts/collect-reports.mjs "$LHCI_FORM_FACTOR" && exit $status; }; fi

localOnlyGates.gate:lh: lighthouse measures a browser under load, so a shared CI runner is the wrong instrument: on GitHub's hosted runners the matrix took most of the wall time of every run and still produced 97-99 scores that had to be re-run. It runs locally instead, sharded across workers by scripts/run-lh-parallel.mjs with a watchdog that stops a shard running far past its peers, npm run lh:record then writes the evidence, and .githooks/pre-push refuses to push a tree no recorded passing run has measured (lh:check); recording is a separate command so a planted specimen can prove this gate fails without writing evidence about its own defect; the owner asked for this on 2026-10-16
localOnlyGates.gate:lh:one: one form factor of gate:lh, invoked by it twice; local for the same reason. The bookkeeping around it is deliberately not named gate:*: lh:record writes audits/lighthouse-green.json after a green local run and lh:check is the pre-push refusal, and a CI runner must never be able to vouch for a lighthouse run it did not perform
localOnlyGates.audit:polish: run-polish-sweep.mjs walks the built dist at six widths with a real Chromium instance and writes audits/phase-5/polish-sweep.md as generated evidence for one phase; it is run manually when that phase is reviewed, not per commit
localOnlyGates.audit:prelaunch: run-pre-launch.mjs reads other phase-5 audit artifacts (REPORT.md, polish-sweep.md) already committed under audits/, and re-runs the visual and cross-browser Playwright suites; it is the manual pre-launch checklist run once before shipping, not a per-commit CI gate (tracked as a residual gap: docs/plan/reference/known-gaps.md#G3)
localOnlyGates.smoke:prod: run-smoke-prod.mjs makes live HTTP requests against the production origin (default https://meshin.co) and writes audits/phase-5/smoke-prod.md; it can only run after a real deploy, not from a CI build artifact
localOnlyGates.audit:geo: generate-geo-baseline.mjs writes audits/geo-baseline.md, a structural readiness baseline captured once per phase from docs/SEMANTIC-CORE.md and dist, not re-derived every commit
localOnlyGates.audit:geo-probe: run-geo-probe.mjs calls four live external answer-engine APIs (OpenAI and others) and writes audits/geo-probe.md; it is a manual, rate-limited, credentialed probe against third-party services, not a CI-safe per-commit check
localOnlyGates.assets:gaps: generate-gaps.mjs writes audits/phase-4.7/gaps.md from the ledger and registers; it is a generator run manually when the ledger changes, not a gate CI needs to enforce every commit
localOnlyGates.assets:routes: routes-gate.mjs --write rewrites audits/routes.json, the ledger gate:routes compares the build against; it is run by hand in the commit that changes the route set on purpose, because a CI run before gate:routes would compare the build with itself and pass every time
